Not sure I agree hiding all D-Bus errors is best but :shrug:
Edited the commit message as the handler now swallows `EBADR`.
Overall I am okay
Restructured to follow the same pattern. Thanks for acknowledging this!
Have a check for empty since UUID must be in a format ? That comment would be helpful
Added an empty-string checking for the situation and will return immediately without populating that empty string to the response JSON.
Addressed all 3 review comments, thanks for the reviews!
print the EC, that is the most valuable part of this trace

Done and the latest PS now logs the full `ec`.
Thanks for acknowledging!

Changes in Boost 1.91.0
```
    Added from_chars to boost/uuid/uuid_io.hpp.
    Added a noexcept operator() overload to string_generator.
```
https://www.boost.org/doc/libs/latest/libs/uuid/doc/html/uuid.html

Can we move to 1.91 ?
https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/5137a404e15984311ad4e5836880f49fb27dde18/subprojects/boost.wrap#L2
Why are we parsing this as a UUID at all?

Since the `bmcweb` is still pinned to Boost 1.90 and the 1.91 bump is some weeks out and I didn't want to gate this on it. 

In addition, I have removed the format checking for `UUID` and currently we will just have empty case checker.

If we really want to have format checker for UUID, I think we can wait until `bmcweb` to be upgraded to `boost v1.91.0` and I can then uploaded a patch for them.
lets not pull in a full dependency just for a uuid.  To some extent we can "trust" dbus is correct.
Done, discarded the uuid-format checker in PS8.
I would've probably made this a length check, and force stuff to upper case, but up to you if you don't want to do that.
Done, added a length check for the retrieved UUID, and did the uppercase transformation as suggested.
if it's empty we should be setting nullptr right?
Sorry, but I am not sure if you are suggesting to set `nullptr` into the `asyncResp->res.jsonValue["UUID"]`, or using nullptr to determine if `uuid` is an empty string.

Why do we have to do this for other UUIDs ?

https://github.com/openbmc/bmcweb/blob/e5cd5009b23255637dd7f11701a65d8c8fa09b88/redfish-core/lib/chassis.hpp#L429

Hi, 
I was enlighted by Ed in the comment above to transform the `UUID` into the uppercase. This can be removed since it is not strictly necessary but just an advancement.
Why getAllProperties ? When only 1 property ?

The reason to use `getAllProperties()` instead of `getProperty()` is that I want to retrieve the pointer so that I can perform the uppercase transformation.

However, since we are going to remove the uppercase transformation, I think we can move to `getProperty` here.

The CI seems to be broken. 
Might have to wait until it is fixed?
